title: Making Harvest Moon Stardew Valley Like Game

posts.author: Wisepot
posts.body:
Making Harvest Moon Stardew Valley Like Game
hi, guys i am just sharing video tutorial about making this kind of game with you all​
Brief description:
this is video tutorial about making stardew valley or harvest moon like game or features in rpg maker mv mz
Requirements:
RPG maker MZ or MV and many Plugins - 99 % plugin free to dl you can find them on forum or google
Video list
1 - Making Custom Time System and Hud
2 - Making Day Night System And Season System Changing Map to Day Night And Normal and Snow
3 - Bed System And Weather System - Snow and Rain Fall on Map
4 - Player Health Bar And Stamina Bar Custom UI Making
5 - Making Player STamina bar go down when he running
6 - Sending Player back to House When STamina is Zero Or Health is Zero
7 - Making TV System Like staredew or Harvst Moon - Tell us today and 2mow weather
8 - Making Hero Equip TOols and Items on Press of Button E and display Hud
9 - First Step Farming Using Hoe to make farm plot and shovel to destory it
10 - Our first harvest Carrot, Planting it , watering it and harvesting after 5 days
11 - REgorwable plants or Tree after each day get furits
12- Custom RElation Book
13 - horse riding movement speed
14- custom title screen similar to harvest moon
15 - custmom title scene bus moving to town like stardew valley
